edge_guard_rule: all induction-residual, velocity-coverage and helicity-flux integration masks are eroded from the crop boundary by 12 pixels; high-confidence/50G requirements still apply

DAVE4VM_preprocessing.spatial_derivative: pyflowmaps.math_tools.odiff divided by CEA metric pixel size in km
DAVE4VM_preprocessing.nonfinite_inside_crop: zero-filled only for solver convolution; never admitted to integration mask

velocity_perpendicularization: v_perp = v - (v dot B) B / |B|^2 using midpoint B; pixels with |B|^2=0 are excluded

potential_vector.implementation: scipy.signal.fftconvolve with explicit full-convolution center extraction

time_reversal: rerun DAVE4VM with start/stop swapped and same positive delta_t
